test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: As per the National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2021, which of the following states has the least population under poverty?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Sikkim**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the **National Multidimensional Poverty Index Report 2021**, **Sikkim** has the least population living under poverty.
 
• This index is based on various **dimensions of poverty** such as education, health, and living standards.
 
• **Sikkim** has made significant progress in areas like **education** and **healthcare**, leading to a lower poverty rate.
 
• The state’s focus on **sustainable development** and **inclusive growth** has contributed to its low poverty levels.
 
• Government initiatives and policies in Sikkim have been effective in providing **basic amenities** and improving the **quality of life** for its residents.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Tamil Nadu**__

 __
 
• **Tamil Nadu** has also made significant strides in reducing poverty but still has a higher population under poverty compared to Sikkim.
 
• The state has a robust **industrial base** and **social welfare programs** that contribute to poverty alleviation.
 
 
 
• **Himachal Pradesh**__
 __
 
• **Himachal Pradesh** has lower poverty levels due to its focus on **rural development** and **agriculture-based economy**.
 
• The state's efforts in promoting **tourism** and **hydropower projects** have also helped in economic development.
 
 
 
• **Punjab**__
 
 
• **Punjab** is known for its **agricultural productivity** and relatively higher **standard of living**.
 
• Despite these advantages, the state still faces challenges in reducing poverty in certain regions.
